name: Polaris
tagline: A hospital paging system that classifies alerts, routes them to the right clinician in seconds and hands off a short SBAR brief.
problem: Nurses still guess who is on call and available, losing minutes in emergencies, the team says.
solution: Fetch.ai agents classify a plain-English or voice alert by priority, extract room and specialty, pull the patient record, page a clinician, escalate on decline or timeout, and generate a sub-100-word SBAR brief on accept.
demo_moment: Team-described: submit a chest-pain alert and watch the dispatch, the page and the brief.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Social Impact Hack” among 307 submissions.
Targets a concrete hospital bottleneck rather than diagnosis.

lessons: Pick the operational step around the clinical decision, not the decision itself.
